div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; font-size: 22px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MUFASA Application Layer

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mobile web app - request
Question, cancel or feedback action
UI only: no model, graph, database or corpus
Paired local Wi-Fi; no internet

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9B - Mobile web app
Full Ask, Compare and Coverage views
Progress, validated answer and selected excerpts
Dynamic responses are not cached

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1A - Tauri desktop request
Question, cancel or host-control action
Primary launcher and controller
Works with every radio disabled

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1B - Share on local Wi-Fi
Off by default
QR/pairing code to short-lived session token
Revoke token and close listener when disabled

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 - Laptop-local FastAPI service
Serves the bundled interface and API
One request path for desktop and mobile

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What sits on the laptop
MUFASA 4-bit GGUF
Ladybug graph, full-text, vectors and quoted spans
Bundled extensions and interface assets
No PDFs.

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 - Resource governor
One generation across both clients
Context, output, thread and graph-buffer caps
Cancel frees the active work

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 - Retrieve - Layer 3
Full-text and vector, then one hop
6 to 10 Observations with quoted spans

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 - Return evidence first
Selected excerpts can appear before generation
Only display data crosses to the phone

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 - MUFASA generates - Layer 2
llama.cpp, short answer by default
Progress stages shown, raw tokens not streamed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 - Validate before display
Numbers, units and citations match their evidence?
Safety route for medical and structural questions

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Retry that claim once,
then soften the answer

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 - Verified response
Answer, selected evidence excerpts and pages
Confidence, condition match and corpus coverage

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9A - Tauri desktop app
Ask and Evidence
Compare Studies and disagreement matrix
Coverage and Sources

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10 - Laptop feedback file
Optional thumbs down saved with evidence used
Read by a person - nothing trains automatically

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scored separately
The GGUF is run directly through llama.cpp tooling
Pinned settings and plain chat template
No graph, no app - so the model must stand alone
